##: 同花顺AI版, the former 同花顺远航版 (this manifest was ths-yhb); the app identifies itself as Hevo.App and the CDN file is THS_hevo_gc_*.exe. The download/id/275 endpoint always redirects to the newest build, which would silently break the hash on every upstream release, so this manifest pins the versioned CDN file instead. No checkver: the only machine-readable version API (ai.10jqka.com.cn/voyageversion) is the release-notes feed, not a build feed - it still reports 15.0.1.33 while the CDN serves 15.0.1.38 - so autoupdate would downgrade the pin. To bump: read the Location of download/id/275, update version + url, rerun bin/checkhashes.ps1.
description: [同花顺AI版] 同花顺官方PC客户端（原远航版），提供股票行情与交易服务，主打 AI 助手与可定制工作台
